correctness.rationale: For a distinguished chord, isolation requires even open-arc sizes 2r and 2s, s=n-1-r, and separate uniform matchings. Its event has probability w and reduces the crossing mean by (n-1+rs)/3. Summing the indicators by rotational symmetry (two endpoints per chord) contributes a factor n. The terms r=0,n-1 are precisely simple chords and removing them gives Z, including the empty sum at n=2. The two r=1 or s=1 terms for n>=4 have total covariance -2n/[3(2n-1)]; the ratio (2r+1)/(2s-1) gives geometric decay from r=2 to floor((n-1)/4) and a negligible middle after polynomial weighting. Hence the asserted sparse-isolate mean, limiting covariance contribution, and total constant follow. Independent bitmask enumeration reproduced the exact Z mean and three covariances on all 146598 matchings at n=2..7 (python3 /workspace/branches/reproduce_reviews.py 4). This is bounded, not the proof of the general law.
